pipeline_name: EXP-004 Frozen Champion Resumable Production Pipeline

architecture.retrieval_blocker: B5 (RareTokenIndex on name_norm and address_norm, country-aware fallback to cross-country)
architecture.candidate_ranking: Formula 2 (Deterministic logarithmic token-IDF + postal code agreement + corroboration + Jaccard overlap)
architecture.feature_pipeline: 47 features (Slice A baseline + Slice B token-IDF + Slice C char n-grams + Slice D structure + Slice V3a tolerant numeric)
architecture.conflict_resolution: Greedy unique-owner resolution (argmax probability per candidate across all S1)

resumable_execution_engine.atomic_writes: Enabled (.tmp -> row-count and SHA-256 validation -> atomic rename to .tsv)
resumable_execution_engine.crash_recovery: Automated (skips verified completed chunks and resumes from exact point of interruption)
resumable_execution_engine.global_conflict_resolution: Two-stage streaming: candidates written per chunk; p >= 0.82 predictions streamed; global argmax applied during final assembly

performance_and_hardware.hardware_specs: AMD/Intel 16 CPU cores, 24 GB RAM, Windows PowerShell, Python 3.14
performance_and_hardware.peak_memory_single_process: 13.6 GB to 17.6 GB (safe within 24 GB RAM)
performance_and_hardware.projected_parallel_runtime_hours: 5.2 to 5.5 hours with 4 parallel chunk workers
